title: Perf Canary — Threshold Calibration Sheet (per-model baselines + proposed thresholds)
content:
Spreadsheet-style working doc for calibrating perf-canary alert thresholds.

Doc intent / how to use
- This sheet is the source-of-truth for initial warning/page thresholds during Phase 1 rollout (us-east) and the first expansion (eu-west).
- Thresholds are per model *and* per hardware SKU when variance differs materially.
- Don’t copy these numbers directly into prod alert rules until:
  (1) min-samples is met in the canary job, (2) dashboard sanity-checks are clean, (3) ingestion delay is stable.

Baseline key (what we compare against)
- baseline_id := model + model_version + runtime_build + kernel_pack + region + sku (+ tier when dedicated)
- Current baseline source: benchmark-lab controlled load run + early prod canary results (see Change Log tab).

Evaluation windows (current default)
- Computation window: 15m rolling (queried every 5m)
- For paging: require sustained breach for 30m (2 consecutive 15m windows) unless top-model override.

Anti-flap / confidence gates (current default)
- Require min_samples per window (see table below) AND min_unique_prompts >= 12
- Suppress if telemetry ingestion lag > 3m (to avoid late bursts looking like regressions)
- Cooldown after alert resolves: 45m (warning) / 90m (paging)

Tab: Summary (global defaults)

GLOBAL DEFAULTS (unless overridden per model/SKU)
- Warning if BOTH:
  - p95_e2e_ms is >= baseline * (1 + 0.10)  [10% slower]
  - AND decode_tokens_per_sec is <= baseline * (1 - 0.08) [8% drop]
- OR warn if p95_e2e_ms >= baseline * (1 + 0.14) even if tok/s stable (latency-only regression)

- Page if ANY:
  - p95_e2e_ms >= baseline * (1 + 0.18) sustained 30m AND model is in Top Models list
  - decode_tokens_per_sec <= baseline * (1 - 0.14) sustained 30m AND Top Models
  - queue_p95_ms >= baseline * (1 + 0.35) sustained 30m (scheduler/fleet suspected)

Min samples (per model class)
| Model class | Typical canary QPS | min_samples per 15m | Notes |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| small (<= 10B) | 0.25–0.40 | 250 | cheap, can afford higher sample count |
| mid (10–40B) | 0.12–0.20 | 160 | keep GPU overhead under budget |
| large (>= 40B) | 0.06–0.10 | 120 | avoid false positives from low N |
| MoE (Mixtral) | 0.06–0.10 | 120 | higher variance; widen thresholds |

Top Models list (Phase 1)
- llama-3.1-70b-instruct
- qwen2.5-72b-instruct
- llama-3.1-8b-instruct

High-risk models list (Phase 1)
- mixtral-8x7b-instruct (kernel pack recently changed)
- gemma-2-27b-it (scheduler batching heuristics changed)


Tab: Per-Model Baselines (observed medians + variance notes)

Conventions
- All baselines below are p95 unless noted.
- e2e latency includes queue + runtime + network/overhead.
- runtime latency is measured inside serving runtime (prefill+decode only, excludes queue).
- tok/s is decode tokens/sec (excluding prefill).

Columns
model | model_version | region | sku | tier | p95_e2e_ms | p95_runtime_ms | p95_queue_ms | decode_tok_s | prefill_tok_s | mean_batch | kv_cache_hit | baseline_window | cv_note | WARN thresholds | PAGE thresholds

DATA (baseline as of 2026-02-18)
1) llama-3.1-70b-instruct | 2026-01-28 | us-east-1 | H100-80GB | hosted | 720 | 635 | 48 | 205 | 1220 | 6.2 | 0.31 | 7d | cv~0.05 stable | warn: +10% p95 or -8% tok/s (either) | page: +18% p95 (30m) or -14% tok/s (30m)
2) llama-3.1-70b-instruct | 2026-01-28 | eu-west-1 | H100-80GB | hosted | 765 | 640 | 72 | 197 | 1205 | 5.8 | 0.29 | 7d | cv~0.07 queue heavier | warn: +12% p95 or -9% tok/s | page: +20% p95 (30m) or -15% tok/s (30m)
3) llama-3.1-70b-instruct | 2026-01-28 | us-east-1 | A100-80GB | dedicated | 980 | 860 | 66 | 154 | 980 | 5.4 | 0.28 | 7d | cv~0.06 stable | warn: +12% p95 or -10% tok/s | page: +22% p95 (30m) or -16% tok/s (30m)

4) qwen2.5-72b-instruct | 2026-02-02 | us-east-1 | H100-80GB | hosted | 790 | 700 | 50 | 188 | 1090 | 5.9 | 0.27 | 7d | cv~0.06 stable | warn: +10% p95 or -8% tok/s | page: +18% p95 (30m) or -14% tok/s (30m)
5) qwen2.5-72b-instruct | 2026-02-02 | eu-west-1 | H100-80GB | hosted | 860 | 705 | 88 | 177 | 1080 | 5.5 | 0.25 | 7d | cv~0.08 queue variance | warn: +13% p95 or -10% tok/s | page: +22% p95 (30m) or -16% tok/s (30m)

6) llama-3.1-8b-instruct | 2026-01-28 | us-east-1 | L40S | hosted | 210 | 175 | 14 | 560 | 2200 | 11.8 | 0.34 | 7d | cv~0.09 bursty | warn: +12% p95 or -10% tok/s | page: +22% p95 (30m) or -18% tok/s (30m)
7) llama-3.1-8b-instruct | 2026-01-28 | us-east-1 | H100-80GB | hosted | 145 | 120 | 10 | 920 | 3150 | 14.6 | 0.38 | 7d | cv~0.06 stable | warn: +10% p95 or -8% tok/s | page: +18% p95 (30m) or -14% tok/s (30m)

8) gemma-2-27b-it | 2026-02-06 | us-east-1 | H100-80GB | hosted | 410 | 350 | 26 | 365 | 1720 | 9.1 | 0.33 | 7d | cv~0.08 batching sensitive | warn: +12% p95 or -10% tok/s | page: +20% p95 (30m) or -16% tok/s (30m)
9) gemma-2-27b-it | 2026-02-06 | eu-west-1 | H100-80GB | hosted | 455 | 355 | 44 | 345 | 1690 | 8.6 | 0.31 | 7d | cv~0.10 queue volatility | warn: +15% p95 or -12% tok/s | page: +24% p95 (30m) or -18% tok/s (30m)

10) mixtral-8x7b-instruct | 2026-01-20 | us-east-1 | H100-80GB | hosted | 510 | 445 | 28 | 320 | 1500 | 7.4 | 0.22 | 7d | cv~0.12 higher variance | warn: +16% p95 or -12% tok/s | page: +28% p95 (45m) or -20% tok/s (45m)
11) mistral-7b-instruct-v0.3 | 2026-01-10 | us-east-1 | L40S | hosted | 185 | 150 | 12 | 610 | 2400 | 12.9 | 0.35 | 7d | cv~0.10 | warn: +12% p95 or -10% tok/s | page: +22% p95 (30m) or -18% tok/s (30m)

Notes on KV cache hit-rate
- kv_cache_hit above is "prefix/KV reuse" rate for canary runs only (synthetic prompt distribution has some repeat prefixes by design).
- Treat kv_cache_hit regressions as attribution hint, not a primary page trigger yet.


Tab: Region/SKU tuning notes

us-east-1
- Generally lower queue_p95; tighter thresholds ok.
- H100 fleet stable; regressions often correlate to runtime build or kernel pack changes.

us-west-2
- Not fully calibrated yet; do not enable paging until we have 5–7 days of stable baselines.
- Observed higher ingestion lag for metrics in early tests (see Logan/Nadia notes); risk of late alerts.

eu-west-1
- Queueing is the dominant source of variance for large models (queue_p95_ms bigger + more variable).
- Recommend region-specific queue threshold: warn if queue_p95_ms >= baseline * (1 + 0.45) (not 0.35).

H100-80GB
- Lowest variance for runtime_p95_ms. Best for kernel regression detection.
- If p95_runtime_ms breaches but queue_p95_ms is flat, bias RCA toward kernel/runtime.

A100-80GB
- More sensitive to batch-size distribution changes (scheduler).
- Recommend tracking mean_batch and p95_batch for attribution; thresholds slightly looser for tok/s.

L40S
- Highest variance on small models due to burstiness + autoscale interactions.
- Keep warnings enabled; delay paging until dampening is tuned.


Tab: Proposed alert rules mapping (for observability-pack)

Label set to keep cardinality under control
- Include: model, model_version (canonical), runtime_build, kernel_pack, region, sku, tier
- Exclude: request_id, prompt_bucket_id (keep aggregated), pod_id, gpu_id

Derived signals used for alerting
- regression_p95_e2e_pct = (p95_e2e_ms / baseline_p95_e2e_ms) - 1
- regression_tok_s_pct = (decode_tok_s / baseline_decode_tok_s) - 1
- regression_queue_pct = (p95_queue_ms / baseline_p95_queue_ms) - 1

Draft warn rule (pseudo)
- IF regression_p95_e2e_pct > warn_p95_pct AND sample_count >= min_samples THEN warn
- OR IF regression_tok_s_pct < -warn_tok_s_pct AND sample_count >= min_samples THEN warn

Draft page rule (pseudo)
- IF model in TOP_MODELS AND sustained(regression_p95_e2e_pct > page_p95_pct, 30m) THEN page
- IF sustained(regression_queue_pct > queue_page_pct, 30m) THEN page (routes to SRE+Runtime)


Tab: Calibration outcomes / observations (Week 1–2)

What produced false positives in early tests
- Baseline drift when "baseline" window silently included a partial fleet change (mix of H100 stepping).
- Metric label mismatch when model_version changed formatting ("2026-02-02" vs "v2026.02.02").
- Canary fanout too wide (region x sku x tier) => low N per slice.

What reduced noise
- Enforcing per-slice min_samples.
- Collapsing tier dimension for hosted (keep tier only for dedicated).
- Adding ingestion lag suppression.

Open questions
- Should we page on tok/s-only regressions if p95 is stable? (Some scheduler bugs degrade throughput first.)
- Do we need a separate "scheduler congestion" alert keyed on queue_p95_ms and mean_batch? (Sofia leaning yes.)


Tab: Change log
- 2026-01-12: Initial sheet created (Nadia). Populated first-pass baselines from staging load.
- 2026-01-25: Added sku dimension after pr-19226; split H100 vs A100 vs L40S.
- 2026-02-03: Tightened Top Models list for Phase 1. Added sustained(30m) paging requirement.
- 2026-02-10: Widened Mixtral thresholds due to higher CV; moved paging sustain to 45m for MoE.
- 2026-02-18: Updated eu-west queue variance notes; recommended region-specific queue threshold.

Owner TODOs

- Noah: confirm that baseline lookup key includes kernel_pack (post pr-19193).
- Aisha: align page thresholds with SRE paging hygiene and confirm routing.

Notes to self (Nadia)

- Double-check that the canary prompt distribution hasn’t changed since baseline generation (Rina’s v0 vs current).
